shortBio.en: Queen guitarist; Red Special + AC30 layered harmony leads define the band’s guitar choir.
shortBio.zh: Queen 吉他手；Red Special + AC30 多层和声主音定义乐队的吉他合唱。

body.en:
Born 1947. Co-founder of Queen. Homemade Red Special guitar and Vox AC30 stacks produce the wide stereo harmony leads on mid-70s albums. Continues with Roger Taylor on later touring lineups after Mercury.

Constant: tone architecture and harmony arranging more than shred speed.
body.zh:
1947 年生。Queen 联合创始人。自制 Red Special 与 Vox AC30 堆栈做出 70 年代中期专辑的宽立体声和声主音。Mercury 之后与 Roger Taylor 继续后期巡演阵容。

常量：音色建筑与和声编排，多于速弹。
